# Veritask

> Veritask is a Web3 rewards platform where verified users earn real USDT (BEP20) by completing social media and engagement tasks. No deposits, instant on-chain payouts, bot-proof via GoodDollar face verification.

## Pages

- [Home](/): What Veritask is, how it works, trust signals, FAQ.
- [Task Center](/tasks): Browse open paid tasks and submit proof to earn USDT.
- [Sign in](/auth): Create a free account or sign in to start earning.
